howItWorks.title: How Smart Income Buffer Works
howItWorks.step1Desc: Calculates what is normal income over rolling weeks to prevent overspending on big weeks.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Automatically builds an emergency reserve up to 4 weeks of essential expenses.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Maintains a minimum cash floor so you are never left with zero checking liquidity.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Only recommends saving a fraction of your surplus, never forcing you to over-save.
howItWorks.audienceSubtitle: Built for freelancers, rideshare drivers, and gig workers who do not get a fixed monthly paycheck.
